<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a retrosynthetic template whose forward reaction is a cycloaddition that consumes a ketone and an alkyne (i.e., “ketone” and “C‑C triple bond” are broken) and forms the target molecule. I will query the template catalog with these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,

}</action_input>
